sea.label: Laut Jawa
sea.shorelineMethod: simplified straight shoreline aligned with the downstream endpoint of the mapped OSM Ciliwung centerline

riverOutlet.source: downstream endpoint of the ordered OSM Ciliwung ways

notes: Building plan footprints and trees are sourced from the Java OSM archive within 260 m of the complete GPS river centreline; rendered boxes are simplified 3D proxies.
Sparse locations near sensors are supplemented with deterministic low-rise/tree proxies sampled inside mapped OSM residential and green land-use polygons.
Building and tree heights are illustrative estimates because the source layer has no surveyed heights.
Sea shoreline and elevation are a visual connection, not a surveyed coastal or tidal model.
